# Vendored QuickJS-NG

- Upstream: https://github.com/quickjs-ng/quickjs
- Release: v0.16.2
- Commit: `1ab8676f4b6d6d669baeb5f21790fb9734636a20`
- Archive: https://github.com/quickjs-ng/quickjs/archive/refs/tags/v0.16.2.tar.gz
- Archive SHA-256: `97c80625b26775a4c7ca618c004d4ea24cf99cbf867e4eba78bd927a8b23d106`
- Imported: 2026-09-18
- License: MIT; see LICENSE and copyright notices in individual files.

The full release source archive is extracted without its enclosing directory.
No files are omitted or patched. Git submodules are not expanded by the upstream
source archive. UPSTREAM.md is the sole added metadata file. The binding lives
outside this directory. `bash scripts/vendor.sh` verifies this exact archive before replacing
the tree. A maintainer must update its pinned metadata to import another release.
Normal builds and npm installation do not download engine source.
